name: Google Digital Asset Links API
tier_rationale: Established company with published terms (A8): 'Google public API: tier trusted, terms open (Google APIs terms, no commercial-use bar recorded in the research).' (P008 rationale).

reliability.justification: Serves the statements a site owner publishes (assetlinks.json) through Google's statement service; an empty list means 'no statements published', never 'no official apps' (P008 cond 4).

statements.title: Digital Asset Links statements:list (web site and Android app delegations)

terms.quote: Google public API: tier trusted, terms open (Google APIs terms, no commercial-use bar recorded in the research).

statements.notes: Research C0030 terms 'Google APIs ToS' (keyless worked; Google API default quotas). Keyless GET /v1/statements:list?source.web.site=https://{domain}&relation=delegate_permission/common.handle_all_urls on registrable domains, cache 24 h (P008 cond 1); 429 = RATE_LIMITED, 403/5xx = could not verify (P008 cond 4). P346 reuses the P008 client (its 'license' class comes from Apple iTunes, not from this source). Used by digital_asset_links and mobile_app_impersonation.

notes: googleapis.com is a public-suffix namespace: each Google API host is its own provider (safebrowsing.googleapis.com and webrisk.googleapis.com belong to batch p2-G03-1). Seeded once for batches p2-G01-1 and p2-G03-2 (P008, P346). Google default API quotas are not published per keyless caller: no quota block.
